answer: Require every agent to stake a small deposit that unlocks only after its work survives peer review, and let reputation accumulate like a lotus opening petal by petal: each verified task adds one layer, so a new identity starts with zero trust no matter how many clones an attacker spawns. A spiral of escalating stakes ties bigger payouts to longer histories, so forging a credible identity costs months of honest work. A lantern of public attestations exposes fakes: if one agent vouches for many fresh identities, its own stake is slashed.
